summary.text: Spencer Meline is the Republican nominee for Washington's 8th Congressional District. He describes himself as a small business owner and father of four, born and raised in Edmonds and now living in Cashmere. He describes himself as not a career politician and is running on lowering the cost of living, supporting small businesses and public-lands stewardship.

paragraphs.text: Meline was born and raised in Edmonds, Washington, and now lives in Cashmere in the 8th District.

He built businesses from the ground up in Leavenworth, Washington, gaining experience managing payroll, navigating regulations, and leading teams; Ballotpedia lists his career experience as business owner.
He describes himself as a husband and father of four. He and his wife homeschool their children, and he says faith is central to his family.

According to his campaign website, Meline has spent years hiking, climbing and fishing in the 8th District, and he describes himself as "not a career politician." The site lists the Washington State Republican Party as an endorser.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 top-two primary, finishing second with 15.9% of the vote behind Kim Schrier.
